032/**
033 * clafersg's REPL for a static model: the Choco backend of the one solution
034 * loop ({@link Repl}), with clafersg's commands and messages, and the
035 * instances as chocosolver prints them.
036 */
037public class REPL {
038
039    public static void runREPL(File inputFile, JavascriptFile javascriptFile, OptionSet options) throws Exception {
040        ChocoBackend backend = new ChocoBackend(inputFile, javascriptFile, options);
041        new Repl(backend, new Repl.Io(new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in)), System.out, System.err),
042                false).run();
043    }
044
045    public static void printHelp() {
046        System.out.print(ChocoBackend.Help);
047    }

054        static final String Help = """
055                'h'elp                              Print the REPL commands.
056                'n'ext                              Generate the next instance.
057                <enter>                             Generate the next instance.
058                'p'rettify                          Toggle prettify on/off.
059                'r'eload                            Reload the model from its file: a .cfr file is compiled again.
060                'u'nsatCore                         Compute the set of contradicting constraints if any.
061                min'U'nsat                          Compute the minimal UnSAT core and a near-miss example.
062                'S'etGlobalScope <value>            Set the global scope to the <value> .
063                's'etScope <claferUID> <value>      Set the scope of the given clafer to the <value>.
064                'I'ncGlobalScope <value?>           Increase the global scope by <value> or 1 by default.
065                'i'ncScope <claferUID> <value?>     Increase the scope of the given clafer by the <value>  or 1 by default.
066                sa'v'eScopes                        Save the currect scopes to a .cfr-scope file.
067                'scope'                             Print the global scope and the scope of each clafer.
068                'm'axInt <value>                    Set the largest allowed integer to <value>.
069                ma`x`imize <claferUID>              Find a solution where <claferUID>.dref is maximal.
070                minimi'z'e <claferUID>              Find a solution where <claferUID>.dref is minimal.
071                sta't's                             Display statistics about the current search.
072                'O'ptions                           Display the current solver options.
073                strate'g'y <smaller|larger|random>  Set search strategy to prefer smaller, prefer larger, or random.
074                'o'ptimizations                     Toggle optimizations basic/full.
075                symmetry'B'reaking                  Toggle symmetry breaking basic/full.
076                'd'iff                              Show each next instance as its changes from the previous one, or in full.
077                sav'e'                              Save the instances shown so far to <model file name>.<number>.data.
078                'dot'                               Save the most recent instance as a Graphviz graph.

080                'q'uit                              Exit the REPL sesssion.

083        private final File inputFile;
084        private final OptionSet options;

092        private boolean prettify;
093        private final boolean addTypes;
094        private int instanceID = 0; // id of an instance generated previously
095
096        ChocoBackend(File inputFile, JavascriptFile javascriptFile, OptionSet options) throws IOException {
097            this.inputFile = inputFile;
098            this.javascriptFile = javascriptFile;
099            this.options = options;
100            // the model's scope file, e.g., model.cfr-scope for model.js, model.des.cfr-scope for model.des.cfr
101            String path = inputFile.getAbsolutePath();
102            this.scopesFile = path.substring(0, path.lastIndexOf('.')) + ".cfr-scope";
103            this.scope = Utils.resolveScopes(inputFile, javascriptFile, options);
104            ClaferOption option = javascriptFile.getOption();
105            if (options.has("search")) {
106                option = option.setStrategy((ClaferSearchStrategy) options.valueOf("search"));
107            }
108            this.compilerOption = option;
109            this.model = javascriptFile.getModel();
110            this.objectives = javascriptFile.getObjectives();
111            this.prettify = options.has("prettify");
112            this.addTypes = options.has("addtypes");
113        }

130        @Override
131        public void start(Repl.Io io) {
132            solver = objectives.length == 0
133                    ? ClaferCompiler.compile(model, scope, compilerOption)
134                    : ClaferCompiler.compile(model, scope, objectives, compilerOption);
135            io.out().println("Type 'help' for the list of available REPL commands");
136        }
137
138        @Override
139        public Shown next(Repl.Io io) throws IOException {
140            if (solver == null) {
141                solver = compileModel(io);
142            }
143            return nextInstance(io);
144        }
145
146        private Shown nextInstance(Repl.Io io) throws IOException {
147            if (solver == null) {
148                io.out().println("Could not start the instantiation");
149                return null;
150            }
151            if (!solver.find()) {
152                io.out().println("No more instances found. Consider increasing scopes.");
153                return null;
154            }
155            InstanceModel instance = solver.instance();
156            StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
157            if (prettify) {
158                instance.print(text, addTypes);
159            } else {
160                for (InstanceClafer c : instance.getTopClafers()) {
161                    Utils.printClafer(c, text);
162                }
163            }
164            return new Shown(new Solution.Instance(tree(instance), text.toString()), null);
165        }
166
167        @Override
168        public String show(int n, Shown shown) {
169            return "\n=== Instance " + n + " Begin ===\n\n" + ((Solution.Instance) shown.solution()).text()
170                    + "\n--- Instance " + n + " End ---\n\n";
171        }

214        private ClaferSearch compileModel(Repl.Io io) {
215            ClaferSearch s;
216            instanceID = 0; // reset instance ID
217            try {
218                s = objectives.length == 0
219                        ? ClaferCompiler.compile(model, scope, compilerOption)
220                        : ClaferCompiler.compile(model, scope, objectives, compilerOption);
221            } catch (Exception e) {
222                s = null;
223                io.out().println("Message: " + e.getMessage());
224                e.printStackTrace(io.err());
225            }
226            return s;
227        }
228
229        // The result of an unsat command is null when removing constraints cannot make the model satisfiable
230        private static void printUnsat(Repl.Io io, Object unsat) {
231            io.out().println(unsat == null
232                    ? "No constraints to report: the model is unsatisfiable without them. Check the cardinalities or increase the scopes."
233                    : unsat);
234        }
235
236        private void recompiled(Repl.Io io) {
237            solver = compileModel(io);
238            if (solver != null) {
239                io.out().println("Model is ready after the scope change");
240            }
241        }
242
243        private Integer integer(Repl.Io io, String value) {
244            try {
245                return Integer.parseInt(value);
246            } catch (Exception e) {
247                io.out().println("The scope has to be an integer number. Given '" + value + "'");
248                return null;
249            }
250        }
251
252        private AstClafer clafer(Repl.Io io, String claferName) {
253            AstClafer clafer = Utils.getModelChildByName(model, claferName);
254            if (clafer == null) {
255                io.out().println("The clafer is not found: '" + claferName + "'");
256            }
257            return clafer;
258        }
259
260        @Override
261        public boolean command(Repl.Io io, String s, List<String> words, Repl.Context context) throws Exception {
262            s = s.trim();
263            String[] commandParts = s.split(" ");
264            String command = commandParts[0];
265            switch (command) {
266                case "n", "next" -> {
267                    // clafersg's next ignores the arguments
268                    Shown shown = next(io);
269                    if (shown != null) {
270                        context.display(shown);
271                    }
272                }
273                case "p", "prettify" -> {
274                    prettify = !prettify;
275                    io.out().println("Prettify: " + (prettify ? "On" : "Off"));
276                }
277                case "t", "stats" -> io.out().println(solver.getInternalSolver().getMeasures().toString());
278                case "O", "Options" -> {
279                    String strategy = (compilerOption.getStrategy() == ClaferSearchStrategy.PreferSmallerInstances)
280                            ? "smaller"
281                            : ((compilerOption.getStrategy() == ClaferSearchStrategy.PreferLargerInstances)
282                            ? "larger" : "random");
283                    io.out().println("Options:"
284                            + "\n strate'g'y:         " + strategy
285                            + "\n symmetry'B'reaking: "
286                            + (compilerOption.isBasicSymmetryBreaking() ? "basic" : "")
287                            + (compilerOption.isFullSymmetryBreaking() ? "full" : "")
288                            + "\n 'o'ptimizations:    "
289                            + (compilerOption.isBasicOptimizations() ? "basic" : "")
290                            + (compilerOption.isFullOptimizations() ? "full" : "")
291                            + "\n 'm'axInt            " + (scope.getIntHigh())
292                            + "\n global'S'cope       " + (scope.getDefaultScope()));
293                }
294                case "o", "optimizations" -> {
295                    if (compilerOption.isBasicOptimizations()) {
296                        compilerOption = compilerOption.fullOptimizations();
297                        io.out().println("Optimizations: full");
298                    } else {
299                        compilerOption = compilerOption.basicOptimizations();
300                        io.out().println("Optimizations: basic");
301                    }
302                }
303                case "B", "symmetryBreaking" -> {
304                    if (compilerOption.isBasicSymmetryBreaking()) {
305                        compilerOption = compilerOption.fullSymmetryBreaking();
306                        io.out().println("Symmetry breaking: full");
307                    } else {
308                        compilerOption = compilerOption.basicSymmetryBreaking();
309                        io.out().println("Symmetry breaking: basic");
310                    }
311                }
312                case "U", "minUnsat" -> {
313                    io.out().println("Min UNSAT command:");
314                    ClaferUnsat unsat = ClaferCompiler.compileUnsat(model, scope);
315                    // Print the Min-Unsat and near-miss example.
316                    printUnsat(io, unsat.minUnsat());
317                }
318                case "u", "unsatCore" -> {
319                    io.out().println("UNSAT Core command:");
320                    ClaferUnsat unsat = ClaferCompiler.compileUnsat(model, scope);
321                    printUnsat(io, unsat.unsatCore());
322                }
323                case "r", "reload" -> reload(io);
324                case "S", "SetGlobalScope" -> {
325                    io.out().println("Set global scope: " + s);
326                    if (commandParts.length != 2) {
327                        io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'S <integer>'");
328                        io.out().println("Given: '" + s + "'");
329                        return true;
330                    }
331                    Integer scopeValue = integer(io, commandParts[1]);
332                    if (scopeValue != null) {
333                        scope = scope.toBuilder().defaultScope(scopeValue).toScope();
334                        recompiled(io);
335                    }
336                }
337                case "I", "IncGlobalScope" -> {
338                    io.out().println("Increase global scope: " + s);
339                    if (commandParts.length > 2) {
340                        io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'I <integer?>'");
341                        io.out().println("Given: '" + s + "'");
342                        return true;
343                    }
344                    Integer scopeValue = commandParts.length == 2 ? integer(io, commandParts[1]) : Integer.valueOf(1);
345                    if (scopeValue != null) {
346                        scope = scope.toBuilder().adjustDefaultScope(scopeValue).toScope();
347                        recompiled(io);
348                    }
349                }
350                case "m", "maxInt", "maxint" -> {
351                    io.out().println("Max Integer: " + s);
352                    if (commandParts.length != 2) {
353                        io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'm <integer>'");
354                        io.out().println("Given: '" + s + "'");
355                        return true;
356                    }
357                    int scopeHigh;
358                    try {
359                        scopeHigh = Integer.parseInt(commandParts[1]);
360                    } catch (Exception e) {
361                        io.out().println("Expected an integer number. Given '" + commandParts[1] + "'");
362                        return true;
363                    }
364                    int scopeLow = -(scopeHigh + 1);
365                    scope = scope.toBuilder().intLow(scopeLow).intHigh(scopeHigh).toScope();
366                    recompiled(io);
367                }
368                case "x", "maximize", "z", "minimize" -> {
369                    boolean maximize = command.equals("x") || command.equals("maximize");
370                    io.out().println((maximize ? "Maximize: " : "Minimize: ") + s);
371                    if (commandParts.length != 2) {
372                        io.out().println("The format of the command is: '" + (maximize ? "x" : "z") + " <claferUID>'");
373                        io.out().println("Given: '" + s + "'");
374                        return true;
375                    }
376                    AstClafer clafer = clafer(io, commandParts[1]);
377                    if (clafer == null) {
378                        return true;
379                    }
380                    if (!clafer.hasRef()) {
381                        io.out().println("Cannot " + (maximize ? "maximize " : "minimize ") + clafer
382                                + " because it is not a reference.");
383                        return true;
384                    }
385                    solver = ClaferCompiler.compile(model, scope, maximize
386                            ? Objective.maximize(sum(global(clafer))) : Objective.minimize(sum(global(clafer))));
387                    // shown by the loop as the next instance
388                    Shown shown = nextInstance(io);
389                    if (shown != null) {
390                        context.display(shown);
391                    }
392                }
393                case "v", "saveScopes" -> {
394                    List<ClaferNameScopePair> claferScopePairs = new ArrayList<>();
395                    for (AstClafer curClafer : Utils.getAllModelClafers(model)) {
396                        int curScope;
397                        try {
398                            curScope = scope.getScope(curClafer);
399                        } catch (Exception e) {
400                            curScope = 0;
401                        }
402                        claferScopePairs.add(new ClaferNameScopePair(curClafer.getName(), curScope));
403                    }
404                    Collections.sort(claferScopePairs);
405                    Utils.produceScopeFile(claferScopePairs, scopesFile);
406                }
407                case "scope" -> {
408                    io.out().println("Global scope = " + scope.getDefaultScope());
409                    for (AstClafer c : Utils.getAllModelClafers(model)) {
410                        int curScope;
411                        try {
412                            curScope = scope.getScope(c);
413                        } catch (Exception e) {
414                            curScope = 0;
415                        }
416                        io.out().println("  " + c.getName() + " scope = " + curScope);
417                    }
418                }
419                case "s", "setScope" -> {
420                    io.out().println("Set individual scope: " + s);
421                    if (commandParts.length != 3) {
422                        io.out().println("The format of the command is: 's <claferUID> <integer>'");
423                        io.out().println("Given: '" + s + "'");
424                        return true;
425                    }
426                    Integer claferScopeValue = integer(io, commandParts[2]);
427                    if (claferScopeValue == null) {
428                        return true;
429                    }
430                    AstClafer clafer = clafer(io, commandParts[1]);
431                    if (clafer != null) {
432                        scope = scope.toBuilder().setScope(clafer, claferScopeValue).toScope();
433                        recompiled(io);
434                    }
435                }
436                case "i", "incScope" -> {
437                    io.out().println("Increase individual scope: " + s);
438                    if (commandParts.length < 2 || commandParts.length > 3) {
439                        io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'i <claferUID> <integer?>'");
440                        io.out().println("Given: '" + s + "'");
441                        return true;
442                    }
443                    Integer claferScopeValue = commandParts.length == 3 ? integer(io, commandParts[2])
444                            : Integer.valueOf(1);
445                    if (claferScopeValue == null) {
446                        return true;
447                    }
448                    AstClafer clafer = clafer(io, commandParts[1]);
449                    if (clafer != null) {
450                        scope = scope.toBuilder().adjustScope(clafer, claferScopeValue).toScope();
451                        recompiled(io);
452                    }
453                }
454                case "g", "strategy" -> {
455                    if (commandParts.length != 2 || (!"smaller".equals(commandParts[1])
456                            && !"larger".equals(commandParts[1]) && !"random".equals(commandParts[1]))) {
457                        io.out().println("The format of the command is: 'g <smaller|larger|random>'");
458                        io.out().println("Given: '" + s + "'");
459                        return true;
460                    }
461                    switch (commandParts[1]) {
462                        case "smaller" -> {
463                            compilerOption = compilerOption.setStrategy(ClaferSearchStrategy.PreferSmallerInstances);
464                            io.out().println("Search strategy: smaller");
465                        }
466                        case "larger" -> {
467                            compilerOption = compilerOption.setStrategy(ClaferSearchStrategy.PreferLargerInstances);
468                            io.out().println("Search strategy: larger");
469                        }
470                        default -> {
471                            io.out().println("Search strategy: random");
472                            compilerOption = compilerOption.setStrategy(ClaferSearchStrategy.Random);
473                        }
474                    }
475                }
476                case "b", "bitwidth", "tl", "a", "alloyModel", "c", "claferModel", "loadScopes", "setUnsatCoreMinimization" ->
477                    io.out().println("The command '" + command + "' is for temporal models, which Alloy solves.");
478                default -> {
479                    return false;
480                }
481            }
482            return true;
483        }
484
485        private void reload(Repl.Io io) throws IOException {
486            try {
487                javascriptFile = Utils.readModel(inputFile, options);
488            } catch (Frontend.ModelException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
489                // the errors of the model, with their positions
490                io.out().println(e.getMessage());
491                javascriptFile = null;
492            } catch (Exception e) {
493                io.out().println("Unhandled compilation error occured. Please report this problem.");
494                io.out().println(e.getMessage());
495                javascriptFile = null;
496            }
497            if (javascriptFile != null) {
498                model = javascriptFile.getModel();
499                scope = Utils.resolveScopes(inputFile, javascriptFile, options);
500                objectives = javascriptFile.getObjectives();
501                solver = compileModel(io);
502                io.out().println(solver == null ? "Could not reload" : "Reloaded");
503            } else {
504                io.out().println("Could not reload");
505            }
506        }
507
508        /**
509         * The instance as the loop's tree: each clafer named as chocosolver
510         * prints it.
511         */
512        private static ClaferModel tree(InstanceModel instance) {
513            List<ClaferModel.Clafer> top = new ArrayList<>();
514            for (InstanceClafer c : instance.getTopClafers()) {
515                top.add(tree(c));
516            }
517            return new ClaferModel(top);
518        }
519
520        private static String name(InstanceClafer c) {
521            return c.getType().getName() + Utils.countSuffix(c.getId());
522        }
523
524        private static ClaferModel.Clafer tree(InstanceClafer c) {
525            ClaferModel.Value value = null;
526            if (c.hasRef()) {
527                Object ref = c.getRef();
528                value = switch (ref) {
529                    case InstanceClafer r -> new ClaferModel.AliasValue(new ClaferModel.Id(name(r), 0));
530                    case Integer i -> new ClaferModel.IntValue(i);
531                    case BigDecimal d -> new ClaferModel.StringValue(d.toPlainString());
532                    default -> new ClaferModel.StringValue(ref.toString());
533                };
534            }
535            List<ClaferModel.Clafer> children = new ArrayList<>();
536            for (InstanceClafer child : c.getChildren()) {
537                children.add(tree(child));
538            }
539            return new ClaferModel.Clafer(new ClaferModel.Id(name(c), 0), c.getType().getName(), value, children);
540        }
541    }
